kernelDeploy.about: A Kernel v3.1 account deployed by an operation with empty callData through ZeroDev's FactoryStaker into its KernelFactory, ZeroDev's ECDSA validator as its root (BNB Chain, EntryPoint v0.7). Code read at the operation's parent block.

verifyingPaymaster.about: Coinbase's VerifyingPaymaster for EntryPoint v0.6 on Base (verified on Sourcify: src/VerifyingPaymaster.sol). Its postOp reverts BundlerNotAllowed(tx.origin) where its data's allowAnyBundler byte is 0 and isBundlerAllowed[tx.origin] isn't set. verifyingSigner is in slot 2 and isBundlerAllowed in slot 4 (read against verifyingSigner() and isBundlerAllowed(bundler)).
